M-INSTALL.NAME: DeepSeek Harness installer
M-INSTALL.purpose: Install/uninstall MyGRACE into DeepSeek Harness with validated, atomic config edits and honest exit codes (ADR-7); since v1.3 the `--panel` component is a LIVE status card, not a placeholder (W4.1).

export-MCP_ENTRY_ID.PURPOSE: Loader row id for the MCP client (mcp-mygrace).

export-PANEL_ENTRY_ID.PURPOSE: Loader row id for the status panel.

fn-skillSourceDirs.PURPOSE: Canonical grace-* skill directories shipped with this package.

fn-mcpPatchRow.PURPOSE: MCP loader row in the exact shape DSH expects.

fn-panelPatchRow.PURPOSE: LIVE status-panel loader row (host route GET /api/mygrace.status + browser card); opt-in via --panel.

fn-parsePatchContent.PURPOSE: YAML parse plus top-level array validation.

fn-patchHasRow.PURPOSE: Structural idempotency check against parsed rows.

fn-insertRowInPatch.PURPOSE: Insert a row with YAML validation before and after.

fn-removeRowFromPatch.PURPOSE: Remove a managed block, byte-identical undo.

fn-atomicWriteFile.PURPOSE: Temp file plus rename in the same directory.

contract.purpose: Install/uninstall MyGRACE into DeepSeek Harness with validated, atomic config edits and honest exit codes (ADR-7, W1.4).

error.description: Unparseable cordis.patch.yml, refused before any edit.

notes.note-1: Writes only under $DSH_HOME; no network access.
notes.note-2: Backups are timestamped and never overwritten; uninstall restores the managed block byte-for-byte.
notes.note-3: The MCP row is PATH-free: it records the absolute bun path and the absolute MCP server entry.
notes.note-4: The panel reads real data: its host route spawns `mygrace status --format json` (MYGRACE_BIN → $DSH_HOME launcher, 5 s timeout, never throws → {ok:false,error}).
